steps.title: Read the website
steps.why: Find forms, tracking and anything blocking readers.
steps.detail: We could read the site. 6 pages · forms on 1 · Tag Manager not found · GA4 G-Q7QZZ1J18C

steps.title: Look through your Google account
steps.why: List the Analytics, Tag Manager, Search Console and Sheets you already have, so nothing is duplicated.
steps.detail: Found 3 Analytics properties, 0 Tag Manager containers, 3 Search Console sites, 14 sheets

steps.title: Google Analytics 4
steps.why: Pick the property for this website, or create one with a web stream.

steps.title: Count a lead as a conversion
steps.why: Make generate_lead a key event, so enquiries are measured.

steps.title: Tag Manager
steps.why: Pick the container on the site, or create and publish one with the GA4 tag.
steps.detail: No Tag Manager account under this sign-in (Google doesn't let software create one). The Analytics tag goes on the site directly; Tag Manager can be added later.

steps.title: Put Tag Manager on the website
steps.why: Through the website code if connected; otherwise you get the snippet.
steps.detail: G-Q7QZZ1J18C is already on the site

steps.title: Search Console
steps.why: Pick the verified site, to read what people searched.

steps.title: Leads sheet
steps.why: Pick your leads sheet, or create one with the right columns.

steps.title: Send website enquiries to the sheet
steps.why: So every enquiry is scored, with its campaign and gclid.
steps.detail: The existing sheet is kept as it is

steps.title: Google Ads account
steps.why: Pick the account the campaigns will run in.
steps.detail: Created Google Ads account 3767933146 under test manager 9630005249 · test account: campaigns are real objects, nothing is shown or charged

steps.title: Link Analytics to Google Ads
steps.why: So enquiries count as Ads conversions and bids learn from them.
steps.detail: Google doesn't link Analytics to Google Ads test accounts. This step runs on its own on the real Ads account; until then leads are counted from the leads sheet and Analytics.

steps.title: Decks for buyer questions (Gamma)
steps.why: Optional: decks that answer real buyer questions, drafted under your deck rule (Settings → Website changes).
steps.detail: Optional. Add a Gamma key on Connect → Gamma whenever you want deck drafts

steps.title: Turn on the weekly check
steps.why: Every Monday 9:00: score leads, block waste, read out tests.
